summary: Walmart Inc. filed an 8-K disclosing entry into a Pricing Agreement to issue $4.25B aggregate principal amount of notes across five tranches (Floating Rate Notes due 2029, 4.000% Notes due 2029, 4.150% Notes due 2031, 4.450% Notes due 2033, 4.750% Notes due 2036). Underwriters include Citigroup, J.P. Morgan, Mizuho, Barclays, HSBC, and U.S. Bancorp. Notes sold at par; net proceeds after underwriting discount used for general corporate purposes. No special situation — routine debt financing with no change of control, tender, or restructuring. Expect closing April 30, 2026.
